---
title: "FishualizeR"
subtitle: "Visualisation and quality control of length data"
categories: [data, length composition, QC, Shiny]
---

[Draft]{.status-badge .status-draft} [Showcase entry]{.status-badge .status-showcase}

::: {.fz-lead}
Interactive app that walks users through common visualisation and quality control of fisheries length data, and aggregates it into length compositions.
:::

- **Find errors:** typos, mixed units and impossible values.
- **Understand your data:** what you have, from when, and from which sources.
- **Check coverage:** which years, gears and areas are well sampled.

FishualizeR does not fit a model or assess a stock. It prepares you for tools such as [FLicc](../methods/dynamic-pool/flicc.qmd), [LBSPR](../methods/dynamic-pool/lbspr.qmd) and [LBB](../methods/dynamic-pool/lbb.qmd) by showing whether your data are ready for them.

[Open the FishualizeR Shiny App](http://apps.upwellsolutionsllc.com/app/FishualizeR){.btn .btn-primary} [Where to start](#workflow){.btn .btn-outline-primary}


## What you provide and what you get {#inputs-outputs}

::::: {.fz-flow}

<div class="fz-flow-head"><span>You have</span><span>Key parameters</span><span>Output</span></div>

:::: {.fz-row}
::: {.fz-card .fz-in}
**Data inventory**  
Excel template  
[Template to be added]{.todo}
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-mid}
Data types held, years covered, key events (fishery start, catch peaks)
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-out}
**Timeline of your data**  
Years covered by each data type, with events marked, so gaps and changes are easy to see.
:::
::::

:::: {.fz-row}
::: {.fz-card .fz-in}
**Life history data**  
Excel template  
[Template to be added]{.todo}
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-mid}
Growth, natural mortality, maturity, length-weight
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-out}
**Curves to compare**  
Growth, maturity, length-weight and mortality side by side, to spot conflicting values.
:::
::::

:::: {.fz-row}
::: {.fz-card .fz-in}
**Length data**  
CSV file  
[Example files to be added]{.todo}
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-mid}
Length (individual or per bin), year, gear, area or location
:::
::: {.fz-card .fz-out}
**Plots and compositions**  
Raw-data plots (colour, facets); coverage over time or location; length compositions in set bins.
:::
::::

:::::

::: {.fz-caption}
Each row works on its own. The two templates are optional, but they are the habit worth building: they record what your data are and where they came from.
:::

## Is FishualizeR the right tool? {#right-tool}

:::: {.fz-fit}
::: {.fz-yes}
[Use it to]{.fz-fit-title}

- Take a first look at length samples.
- Check units, gaps and uneven coverage across years, areas and gears.
- Record which data you hold and which events may explain changes.
:::
::: {.fz-no}
[Use something else to]{.fz-fit-title}

- Estimate stock status or fit a model. Use an assessment tool such as [FLicc](../methods/dynamic-pool/flicc.qmd).
- Test harvest control rules or screen management options.
- Judge data quality for you. The app shows problems; you decide what they mean.
:::
::::


## Use and misuse {#use-and-misuse}

::: {.callout-warning title="Before you rely on the results"}
The app shows problems; it does not fix them or judge your data for you.
:::

:::: {.fz-twocol}
::: {.fz-col}
**Check first**

- Units are consistent (for example, not cm mixed with mm).
- Coverage is reviewed by year and by gear.
- Sample size is noted for each gear and year.
:::
::: {.fz-col}
**Common mistakes**

- Pooling gears or areas with different selectivity into one view.
- Ignoring years with very small samples.
- Treating summaries as representative of the catch without checking sampling coverage.
:::
::::
